Guided by Craftsmanship

Things were done differently 100 years ago.

While our lifestyles have changed drastically, certain principles still ring true today.

Through our remodel work we shepherd through the best of it; the attention to detail, the quality, and the craftsmanship (it’s in our name).

We believe in timeless design and construction. In any house, vintage or contemporary, the spaces should integrate seamlessly into their surrounds.

Sometimes we wonder, what were they thinking in the 80s?

Process Oriented

At Craftsman Design and Renovation, we partner with you to remodel your Portland, Oregon kitchen, bathroom, basement, or exterior.

With over 25 years of experience, we’ve been around the block a time or two.

We understand the importance of organization, communication, and careful planning during a remodel.

We guide you through our design-build process and are with you every step of the way.

Relationship Focused

As a design-build firm focused in Portland, our goal is to get to know you, your home, and your vision.

Then, we provide you with the best design solutions and build with the highest-quality craftsmanship in the business.

The end result is a better future: for you, your family, and your home.

And you also leave with a lifelong partner in us.

We hired CDR to renovate our entire 1916 Portland Craftsman home. It was a remarkably successful experience. The entire team, from design to construction, were supportively responsive to design modifications, resourceful at specific detail discussions and were always reliable with communication throughout the entire 1year+ project. Combine that with the quality of the sub contractors skill and project management’s tight scheduling, we’d have to say we were very satisfied with our complete experience.

Picking the Right Company for your Remodel

Over the years, we’ve talked to thousands of people about their remodels – their hopes, ambitions, and dream scenarios. We’ve talked to remodel pros, DIY veterans, novice homeowners, and everyone in between. All of them asking the same question: “Is this the right company to choose for our remodel?”

Who We Are

Our passion for history, craftsmanship, and the beauty of old homes in the Portland, Oregon area shines through in everything we do.
We are old house nerds.

We geek out on original woodwork, built-in details, and the perfect rafter tail.

The Tudor, the four square, the bungalow, the craftsman – they are all old friends near and dear to our hearts.

Some clients have called us forensic architects…a new superpower, perhaps? We’ll take it.

As a full service design-build firm in Portland, Oregon we believe in maintaining the architecture and character of our neighborhoods.

We are great teammates.

We take our time through our design process to ensure the end project will fit your lifestyle to a tee.

All our projects are thoughtfully custom.

We talk shower habits, midnight snacking needs, homework routines. No detail is too small.

After design, our production team executes our design vision, while also providing on-site recommendations and solutions.

The bottom line; we’re the kind of teammate you and your home want to have.

We are doers with a plan.

We run a tight ship.

We believe consistency and communication are keys to a successful remodel.

Our communication and quality of work do not waiver, no matter the type of project.

We create a plan, detail it with you, and systematically deliver – time and time again.

You might even miss us when we’re gone.

Our story: It all started 29 years ago with a love of historic Portland, Oregon and an attic office space. And as they say, the rest is history.
1996
The Beginning

With a passion for Portland’s historic and older homes, Wade Frietag starts Craftsman Design and Renovation out of the attic of his 1905 Craftsman style home.

2004
Leaving the Nest

A bigger team and increased work leads to CDR ‘leaving the nest’ and establishing new offices on SE Division street. The Craftsman Design team continues to grow and expand to take on more projects.

What We Do
With superior craftsmanship and a design-build process tailored to your home in Portland, we remodel rooms & exteriors that stand the test of time.
Kitchen Remodeling

Kitchens truly are the heart of the home. They are the entertaining space, the homework zone, the family bonding area and so much more. In older homes, the kitchen can often be a difficult (and smaller) puzzle to solve.

Our comprehensive design-build process really shines in kitchen remodels. We take the time to understand you, your cooking needs and wants, as well as your future goals.

Our goal is to work through a space plan with you to ensure your new custom kitchen will fit your needs perfectly. We guide you through cabinetry, countertop, tile, flooring, and many other decisions.

More Kitchen Remodels >

Bathroom Remodeling

Bathrooms are a space we interact with every single day. With the right design, they can provide calm in the morning and a relaxing sanctuary in the evening.

While a small space in the grand scheme of a home, bathrooms can have a huge impact on how you feel on a daily basis. Having enough storage, a good shower, and room for everyone in the family can have a monumental impact on your day to day experience.

Partnering with us and taking the time to think through your needs and habits ensures that your new custom bathroom will fit you perfectly.

More Bathroom Remodels >

Whole House Remodeling

A whole house remodel can be overwhelming. There are so many parts and pieces to consider, it’s hard to know where to start. That’s why we’re here; to help you every step of the way.

Through our design-build process, we take our time to understand your home and your needs, to ensure the best plan is developed; whether that’s remodeling the whole house at once, or breaking it out in phases as a longer-term, strategic plan.

We approach whole house remodels holistically, determining how each phase will affect the next, to ensure maximum efficiency and minimum stress.

More Whole House Remodels >

Basement Remodeling

The unfinished basement in a home is like a whole new land, waiting to be explored and developed. This is an area where there is some great opportunity to add valuable square footage to your home.

Whether it be more family room space, an extra office, a wine cellar, or another bathroom (hello teenagers), we’ll help guide you through our design-build process to find the best fit for your family’s needs.

Our goal is to build you a space that will blend with the rest of your old home, while gaining additional functionality and space for your family.

More Basement Remodels >

Interior Remodeling

As lovers of older homes, we appreciate the finer details. Original built-ins, wainscot, crown molding…you are speaking our language.

While a lot of our interior remodeling projects are done in conjunction with projects of a larger scope, we are happy to chat with you about the possibilities. We love to see original details restored and carried on for another 100 years.

Our expert team takes the time to observe original detailing and if needed, conduct additional research to make sure what we’re building honors the character of your home.

More Interior Remodels >

Exterior Remodeling

As Portlanders, we are passionate about our city’s landscape and maintaining and preserving the beautiful architecture of our city.

Bearing the Pacific Northwest weather, in addition to years (often over 100) of wear and tear, the exteriors of our homes need some extra care and attention to look and feel their best.

As experts of older homes, we can help you maintain, recreate, or uncover the original exterior beauty of you home.

Whole House Remodeling
Craftsman Design & Renovation is an award-winning
design-build firm that focuses on renovating older homes in the Portland, Oregon area. Not only do we complete basement, bathroom, and kitchen remodels, but if you are looking to restore your entire home, we can provide you with a whole house remodel that will fit your unique needs.

1902 NW Craftsman Kitchen

In this 1902 NW Craftsman kitchen, thoughtful layout changes brought new life and flow to the heart of the home. Relocating the powder bath door opened up a range of design possibilities, allowing for better circulation and a new peninsula for prep and seating. Original millwork details were carefully replicated, including stained wood, v-groove wainscot, and custom leaded glass transom windows that echo the home’s historic charm. A dramatic soapstone countertop—chosen for its striking, vein-like pattern—became the focal point. Finishing touches like black-and-white hex tile and playful wallpaper add character to this fresh yet timeless renovation.
